conversation.text: Hi, I need to file a warranty claim. The unit you installed last year stopped working.
To file a claim, call to schedule a warranty diagnostic.
If the failure is covered, there is no diagnostic fee, but if the technician determines it is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies (Warranty Policy, Filing a claim).

Since the unit was installed last year, it falls within the 2-year labor warranty on full system installations, and Comfort Club members at the time of installation have a 5-year labor warranty (Warranty Policy, New system installation warranty).
Manufacturer parts warranties are separate and vary by brand, and they require the unit to be registered with the manufacturer, which Meridian does within 30 days of install (Warranty Policy).
To get started, please give me your full name and one of the following: your account number, service address, or phone number.
